interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to include a dedicated bike lane or wider buffers, which naturally slows traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked mid-block or intersection crosswalks with high-visibility paint and signage.

interventions.title: Regular Sanitation Services
interventions.description: Establish a consistent schedule for trash collection to ensure the sidewalk remains clear of physical obstructions.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Prune or replace dense, high-profile bushes with low-lying plants to maintain clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture or planting zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time, reducing exposure.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone with trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer from moving traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental or ladder-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Waste Management Solutions
interventions.description: Provide designated areas for trash collection that do not encroach on the pedestrian clear zone.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk material and level across the driveway entrance to signal pedestrian priority and encourage slower vehicle turns.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a buffer from traffic and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility crosswalk with a central refuge island to break up the long crossing distance.

interventions.title: Designated Trash Storage
interventions.description: Implement designated off-sidewalk storage areas or enclosures for waste receptacles to maintain a clear pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to ensure low vehicle speeds appropriate for a high-density residential environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearing
interventions.description: Prune or remove overgrown vegetation to restore the full effective width of the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Speed humps
interventions.description: Add speed humps or cushions to physically slow down traffic in this residential area.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing/Road Diet
interventions.description: Narrow the travel lanes or repurpose space for bike lanes to naturally slow traffic speeds.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add a row of street trees to provide a physical buffer, shade, and a psychological narrowing effect on the road to slow traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Vertical Elements
interventions.description: Planting street trees between the sidewalk and the curb would provide a buffer for pedestrians and create a sense of enclosure that naturally slows traffic.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds along this residential stretch.
